· Social Media · Grow your audience ·
🎵 TikTok — Discovery engine
Best format to reach new fans for free. No explicit content — show your vibe, personality, lifestyle.

— GRWM (Get Ready With Me) : your world, your energy
— Mysterious lifestyle + text "Link in bio for more…"
— Use viral sounds — adapt the trend to YOUR style
— Behind-the-scenes of your shoots (keep it SFW)
— Polls, Q&A, reply to comments in video

Rule : Never mention OnlyFans directly on TikTok. Send to Instagram or Linktree.
📸 Instagram Reels — Your portfolio
Reels get the most reach on Instagram. This is your shop window.

— First 3 seconds are critical — start with your strongest shot
— Use trending sounds (check "Trending" in the app)
— No TikTok watermark on IG Reels — re-export via CapCut
— Post between 6–9 PM weekdays for best organic reach
— Caption CTA : "Want to see more? 👀 Link in bio"
🐦 Twitter / X — Most freedom
X allows adult content (mark as "sensitive") — the only mainstream platform where you can promote directly.

— 2–3 posts/day : teaser photo/video + intriguing text
— Reply to other creators in your niche (cross-visibility)
— Niche hashtags : #OnlyFans #SpicyCreators #[YourNiche]Creator
— Storytelling threads : "Why I started creating content…" → strong engagement
— Polls : "What should I post tonight? 🔥 or 💋 — vote"
🔴 Reddit — Highest converting traffic
Reddit is the #1 source of subscribers who actually pay.

— Find subreddits in your niche (r/onlyfansgirls, r/[yourStyle]...)
— Read each subreddit's rules BEFORE posting
— Post quality teasers with "Check bio for more"
— Never spam — 1 post per subreddit per day max
— Engage on other posts authentically before posting yours

Tip : Subreddits with 50k–200k members convert better than huge ones.
· Content Creation · Photo · Video · Teaser ·
📸 Photos — Stop the scroll
Lighting is everything. Natural light from a side window beats any filter.

— Visual hook : direct eye contact, strong expression, unexpected pose
— Composition : rule of thirds, clean or very textured background
— Edit : Lightroom Mobile (free) — warm preset (+temp, -highlights)
— Caption : question, mystery or CTA. Never descriptive — always intriguing

Batch shoot : 1 session/week (2h) → 7–10 pieces of content. Post daily without working daily.
🎬 Reels & Videos — King format 2025
3-second rule : your audience decides in 3s. Start with your strongest moment.

Viral Reel structure :
1. Hook (0–3s) : close-up shot + bold text or viral sound
2. Body (3–12s) : strong moment, smooth transitions, musical rhythm
3. End (last second) : visual CTA or natural loop

Tools : CapCut (templates + autocut) · InShot (vertical format) · Canva (thumbnails)
✨ Teasers — Controlled frustration
A great teaser gives desire without giving everything. Cut at 70% of the interesting moment.

— Text overlay : "Full version on Honeymoon 👉 link in bio"
— Suggestive sound or mood (no explicit words needed)
— Ideal length : 8–15 seconds

Conversion funnel : TikTok/IG lifestyle → Twitter teaser → Honeymoon full content
· Growth Strategy · Consistency · Convert ·
📅 Consistency — The absolute key
Consistency beats talent. A regular creator who isn't perfect will always beat one who posts masterpieces sporadically.

Minimum posting schedule :
— TikTok : 1 video/day or 5/week
— Instagram : 1 Reel + 2–3 Stories/day
— Twitter/X : 2–3 posts/day
— Honeymoon : per your contract (see "My Formula")

Batch tip : 1 creation day/week, schedule everything with Instagram native app or Buffer.
🤝 S4S — Shoutout for Shoutout
Fastest way to double your audience without spending money.

— You feature the other creator, she does the same
— Target creators with a similar audience (same size, same niche)
— Co-Reels on Instagram : both audiences see the content
— Engage genuinely on their posts BEFORE proposing (cold DM = ignored)

Rule : Quality > quantity. Pick partners whose audience matches your ideal fans.
💰 Sales funnel — Free → Paid
Step 1 — Discovery (Free) : TikTok / IG lifestyle → curiosity
Step 2 — Interest : Twitter / Reddit teasers → desire
Step 3 — Conversion : Honeymoon exclusive + PPV → subscription
Step 4 — Retention : Telegram VIP, personal messages, exclusive offers → loyal fan who refers others
💡 Creator mindset
Top earners treat their work like a real business.

— Analyze your stats weekly : which posts perform? Why?
— Invest progressively : ring light → good phone → mic
— Batch creation : 1 day shooting = 1 week of content
— Rest : 1 day off/week minimum — burnout kills consistency
— Your fans subscribe to YOU, not just content. Authenticity is your competitive edge.
⚠️ Avoid : spamming the same link everywhere (shadowban) · copying without your own twist · ignoring analytics · neglecting fans once you grow.
· Tools & Resources · All free ·
🎬 CapCut FREE →

📸 Lightroom Mobile FREE →
